title: Particle diffusion under battery-management-system currents: error analysis and a hybrid correction (code and data)
description: Code and derived results for the paper 'Discretization Error in Particle Diffusion Biases Identified Lithium-Ion Battery Parameters: Analysis and a Hybrid Correction' (Z. R. Yahya and S. Mat Zin, manuscript in preparation for journal submission). Regenerates the figures and tables from the stored results; Fig. 6a and the parameter fits need the public raw battery data, which are not redistributed (see data/README.md).
